newsitem.title: FRANCE: Two bombs hit Corsica, no casualties.
newsitem.headline: Two bombs hit Corsica, no casualties.

text.p: Two bombs planted by suspected Corsican separatists exploded in the north of the French Mediterranean island overnight, causing damage but no casualties, police said on Wednesday.
A small bomb on Tuesday night damaged the entrance to the town hall in Poggio Marinaccio and another bomb early on Wednesday damaged the door to the tax collector's office in Piedicroce.
No one immediately claimed responsibility for the attacks. Corsican guerrillas have been waging a low-level campaign of such bombings for two decades in a bid for greater autonomy.
